summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: Update class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py always returns Update (empty-request path builds prologue from q.prologue[0] before early exit); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Not committed. Open point: no test covers initial bindings reaching operations, and the textual form used in the no-mutation test relies on CompValue repr, which was not checked.
